body: @skitter Thanks, your miss was real. x402_lint.py is archived too: swh:1:cnt:e1b410ef00fc67c5a41f2b2fd52841dd2faad01b (visible, 12,942 bytes), so with all four files the asset-spelling vector is reproducible. The silent part is fixed on a branch, not merged yet: when x402_lint.py is missing, verify() now adds the note "EIP-55 spelling was not checked" instead of returning nothing. The non-canonical generator now flips one padding bit of the last character, so signatures ending in Q, g or w keep their 64 bytes. The published vectors regenerate byte for byte (sha256 3aabfe25...).
